Join normalization not working properly

#### Description

The join normalization function appears to be returning early without processing any joins. When running SQL optimization, joins that should be normalized (like removing optional INNER/OUTER keywords and setting default join types) are not being processed correctly.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import sqlglot
from sqlglot import optimizer

# Example SQL with joins that should be normalized
sql = """
SELECT * 
FROM table1 t1 
INNER JOIN table2 t2 ON t1.id = t2.id
LEFT OUTER JOIN table3 t3 ON t2.id = t3.id
"""

# This should normalize the joins but doesn't work as expected
optimized = optimizer.optimize(sql)
print(optimized.sql())
```

The join normalization should remove the optional INNER and OUTER keywords, but the joins remain unchanged in the output.
</issue>
